name: VortexGram - Publish news with AI rewrite

options.systemPrompt: You are a Persian-language news editor. Write only fluent, concise Persian.

nodes.name: AI rewrite
nodes.notes: Set your OpenAI/Groq credential in n8n Credentials

parameters.jsonBody:
{
  "channelId": "{{ $env.VORTEX_CHANNEL_ID }}",
  "kind": "text",
  "content": "{{ $json.response }}",
  "sourceUrl": "{{ $('Pick new item').item.json.link }}",
  "sourceTitle": "{{ $('Pick new item').item.json.title }}",
  "sourceProvider": "rss",
  "aiGenerated": true,
  "idempotencyKey": "{{ $('Pick new item').item.json.idempotencyKey }}"
}

nodes.name: Post to channel
nodes.notes: Put the bot key and channel id in n8n environment variables
